description: Where the Sun, Moon and planets are in the zodiac at a moment (now when no date is given): signs and degrees, which planets are retrograde, aspects between them, the Moon's sign, phase and next sign change, the next new and full moon. With a place it adds the ascendant, midheaven and houses. For questions like "what sign is the Moon in today" or "is Mercury retrograde now".

lang.description: Language of the names in the answer: pl (default) or en

place.description: A town or city, e.g. "Opole", "Kraków", "London"; the first match is used (Polish places come first)

time.description: HH:MM clock time in tz (default 12:00 when a date is given)

tz.description: IANA time zone of date and time and of the answer's times (default: the place's, else Europe/Warsaw)

name: sky_at
title: Planets at a moment
